title: Neon Pulse — Episode 75: Coordinates Unknown
description: Kael analyzes the encrypted data drive in the neon-lit alleys, only to discover a terrifying signal broadcasting directly to his neural link.
character_reference: a tall, lean man with messy dark hair, wearing a worn charcoal-grey tactical jacket with glowing amber circuitry patterns running down his sleeves

scenes.narration: The damp asphalt reflects the harsh neon glow above as the decrypted coordinates begin to resolve on the salvaged drive.
scenes.visual: Low-angle close-up of hands holding a glowing data terminal casting blue light onto wet pavement in a dark narrow alleyway cinematic lighting

scenes.narration: Lines of restricted military architecture flash across the screen, revealing an underground facility buried deep beneath the sector boundary.
scenes.visual: Over-the-shoulder view looking at complex wireframe blueprints of an underground bunker displayed on a handheld holographic screen with glowing cyan interface lines

scenes.narration: Without warning, the amber circuitry on his jacket flares brightly, syncing with a fierce pulse radiating from the terminal.
scenes.visual: Medium shot of the protagonist gasping in surprise as intricate amber patterns on clothing flare intensely illuminating the dark surroundings with warm light

scenes.narration: A sharp static pierces his auditory cortex, overriding his thoughts with an automated transmission from an unknown source.
scenes.visual: Close-up of the protagonist wincing in pain with eyes closed tightly, clutching the side of his head in a dimly lit industrial corridor

scenes.narration: A synthesized voice echoes inside his mind, reciting his exact coordinates and confirming that Vance was only a subordinate.
scenes.visual: Wide atmospheric shot of an empty concrete industrial courtyard at night with a single flickering overhead light casting long dramatic shadows

scenes.narration: He draws his sidearm as heavy mechanical footsteps begin to resonate from the shadows at the far end of the alley.
scenes.visual: Low angle shot of the protagonist holding a futuristic weapon in a defensive stance, looking intently down a dark rain-slicked passage

scenes.narration: Red targeting lasers cut through the thick fog, locking onto his chest from multiple elevated positions above.
scenes.visual: POV style medium shot showing multiple bright red laser sight dots projecting across the protagonist's tactical jacket against a backdrop of deep shadows

scenes.narration: To uncover the mastermind behind the conspiracy, Kael has to survive whatever trap has just been sprung.
scenes.visual: Dynamic action shot of the protagonist leaping sideways behind a concrete barrier as sparks fly from an unseen projectile impacting the wall nearby

scenes.narration: Find out what happens next as the hunt continues. Follow along for more of the story.
scenes.visual: Cinematic portrait of the protagonist staring resolutely forward into the glowing fog with amber light reflecting off wet surfaces in the background
